name: cockpit
description: Makes a Claude Code session's work visible: the running round of tool calls, a per-turn summary, a timeline pane and the files each turn edited.

roundTrace.title: Tool call round tracing
roundTrace.description: While a turn runs, show the current round of tool calls after the spinner; when it ends, add a short summary line with the calls per tool.

roundTraceMaxTools.title: Tools named in the summary
roundTraceMaxTools.description: How many tool names the summary line lists, most used first. The rest are counted as +k more.

timeline.title: Timeline pane
timeline.description: Keep a row per turn (prompt, tool calls, tokens, time, edited files) and add the /cockpit command that opens it in a pane.

editedFiles.title: Edited files band
editedFiles.description: After each turn in a git repository, show above the prompt which files the turn changed and by how many lines. Outside a git repository nothing is shown.
